object: CGCG 074-064 maser disk as observed from Earth
geometry_inputs: one regular time-oriented Lorentz metric g with stated units and domain
regular maser-source and actual receiver proper-clock histories
receiver astrometric tetrad and calibration/frame reduction
actual null incidence branches and their source/receiver event correspondence
source transition history and feature association

forward_outputs.finite_slope: apply declared finite monitoring/channel estimator to predicted histories
forward_outputs.linear_angular_map: J=-omega_o*B_eo in fixed orthonormal quotient-screen bases, B reverse block with same future-affine k

observation_interface.primary: MCP XI spot positions, optical barycentric channels and measured spectral slopes
observation_interface.likelihood: MCP XI B17-B24 conditional baseline, including fitted nonnegative error floors, positive total variances and normalization; no posterior fit performed
observation_interface.source_dynamics: Conventional disk/Kepler/Schwarzschild readout only if consistently realized or controlled in candidate g

summary_interface.source: MCP XIII Table1 CGCG row; same underlying source as XI
summary_interface.portability: Requires source-compatible scalar-map reduction or justified refit; determinant alone is insufficient
summary_interface.summary_to_actual_clock_leg: OPEN until regular reference history, null branch and source-reduction realization supplied

decision: Check a supplied candidate's full forward predictions with an explicitly justified source/statistical model. Existing exposed summaries yield descriptive marginal restrictions only. No UDT fit, rejection or confirmation has been performed.
